fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-07-11 (evening, 19:10): The complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 3,500 was debited instead. The complaint was lodged by Keerthana Sri (9000000319). Nandha Karuppasamy (mobile 9000000113) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100024 as the destination of the transfer. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Mathan Raman (9000000187), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and a bank transaction reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00036, as the mobile number 9000000113 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Bank transaction reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, associate, screenshot, receiving account, apartment complex, bank reference, evening
